### All you need for sports data

As a data provider for several years, we have developed dozens of APIs, including the essential data for each sport to more advanced statistics to match the specific needs of our users

Other sports APIs are also planned in the future

Sports we currently cover

- [Football](https://api-sports.io/#)
- [AFL](https://api-sports.io/#)
- [Baseball](https://api-sports.io/#)
- [Basketball](https://api-sports.io/#)
- [Formula-1](https://api-sports.io/#)
- [Handball](https://api-sports.io/#)

Powerful features await for you

## A complete feature stack ready to help you

We have designed all our APIs to be as efficient as possible, both in terms of data quantity & quality and response time

Each of our APIs has its own documentation that gathers all the information you will need for your development and if ever you have a doubt or a question, we are available by chat to help you

[Know More](https://api-sports.io/#)

#### COVERAGE

Over **2 000** competitions covered and more than **15 years** of historical data

#### LIVESCORE

Real-time games and events updated every **15** seconds

#### CHAT SUPPORT

Our team is on hand to answer your questions directly on our dashboard

#### EASY INTEGRATION

We have built a simple and logical architecture to facilitate your developments

#### PRE-MATCH & LIVE ODDS

Pre-match odds and live odds available in all our plans

#### AFFORDABLE

Prices to suit all budgets, starting at **10$** per month. A free plan is also available

## Widgets

#### Ready to use Widgets

Our widgets are completely free and work with all our plans including the free plan.

- ##### EASY TO INTEGRATE



A simple copy/paste is enough to integrate the widgets to your website or application

- ##### THEMES



Several themes available and more to come. You can also apply your own theme.

- ##### AUTOMATIC UPDATE



Indicate the frequency of data update and the widgets will do the necessary.


![...](https://api-sports.io/public/img/widgets-banner.webp)

## Features you can't miss

- ##### Email alerts



Set up custom alert emails based on API consumption to get notified of anomalies or approaching the daily limit.

- ##### Protect your API-KEY



Add domains or Ips addresses to your whitelist that will be the only ones allowed to use it.

- ##### Live Tester



Test all the API directly from the dashboard without having to write a line of code.

- ##### Teams



Invite members, share access securely, assign API keys per project, and maintain full control over usage and permissions.

## Integrations to make it better

Whathever your programming language, our data works with and remain the same across all platforms

You will find in our documentation examples of code to help you get started quickly

We also have a Github gathering all the libraries developed by our users

[Explore all libraries](https://github.com/api-sports)

## Why you should choose API-SPORTS?

Our services are made to be as simple as possible from the registration to the use of our API, just a few clicks are enough to start

#### It all start by choosing the right tools

When looking for a data provider it is important to select the one that suits you best

- ##### Dashboard



A unique dashboard to manage all the API and your subscription

- ##### Monitoring and tools



Monitor all your requests from the dashboard, by day or by month, useful to identify call peaks

- ##### Support



Chat support directly on the dashboard


* * *

[Sign up](https://dashboard.api-football.com/)
